result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.get_dice_similarity()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Get Dice similarity coefficient between all node pairs. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L9109-L9160){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.get_dice_similarity() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} The Dice coefficient measures similarity between two nodes based on their neighborhood overlap: `Dice(A, B) = 2 × |neighbors(A) ∩ neighbors(B)| / (|neighbors(A)| + |neighbors(B)|)` Range: `[0, 1]` where `0` means no common neighbors and `1` means identical neighborhoods (or same node). Self-similarity is always `1.0`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nested dictionary mapping node IDs to dictionaries of similarity scores. Format: `{node1_id: {node2_id: similarity_score}}`. ::: ## Common Use Cases {.doc-common-use-cases} - link prediction (similar nodes likely to connect) - community detection (nodes with similar neighborhoods) - recommendation systems (find similar users/items) ## Examples {.doc-examples} "A" and "D" both connect to "B" and "C", so their neighborhoods overlap completely -- Dice rates that as a perfect `1.0` similarity: ::: {#c29516b2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("A", "C") .add_edge("D", "B") .add_edge("D", "C") ) sim = graph.get_dice_similarity() a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") d_id = graph.get_id_from_label("D") sim[a_id][d_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 1.0 ``` ::: :::
